reviews.title: Solid Budget 850W PSU — Great Value If You Match It With the Right Build
reviews.comment: I bought the Apevia ATX-SL850W Soul 850W for a budget gaming PC build, and overall I think it’s a solid value as long as you understand what you’re buying. The biggest selling point is obvious: 850 watts for the price. That gives you plenty of headroom for a midrange gaming system, extra drives, RGB fans, and future GPU upgrades. Installation was straightforward, the cables were usable, and once installed it powered on cleanly without random shutdowns or weird behavior. Noise has also been fine in my experience; it does not sound loud or distracting during normal use. That said, this is still a budget power supply, so I would not treat it the same as a premium Corsair, Seasonic, EVGA, Super Flower, or high-end Thermaltake unit. If you are running an expensive GPU, heavy overclocking, workstation hardware, or a build where absolute long-term reliability matters, I would probably spend more on a higher-tier PSU with stronger independent reviews and a longer reputation behind it. For the right build, though, this makes sense. I would recommend it for someone putting together a budget or midrange gaming PC who wants a lot of wattage without spending a ton. I would be more cautious using it in a very expensive system where the power supply is the one part you really do not want to gamble on. Bottom line: good value, easy install, quiet enough, and plenty of power for many gaming builds — just know it is a budget PSU and match it with the right system. For the price, I’m happy with it. 🔥
reviews.author: Kevin A.

IS THE MAXIMUM PERIOD I USE MY PC, BUT IM SURE IS NOT OVER HEAT FOR LONG TIME ON.
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.title: very noisy
reviews.comment: Output voltage drops sharply under high load, causing frequent restarts during large-scale games and failing to fully exert the graphics card’s performance; standby power consumption is abnormally high, with continuous power consumption detected by the power meter even after shutdown.
reviews.author: Billie-Jo

reviews.title: Impressive release from Apevia
reviews.comment: I have used Apevia products over the years and typically they are on the lower end and inexpensive PSU products. This is a lovely foray into some slightly higher end power supplies.  The PSU has a nice weight and you can feel the quality especially in the cables and connectors. For a 850w Fully Modular Power Supply its an excellent value.  I was able to quickly and easily plug it all my components with no issues.  Apevia definitely put forth and excellent effort and I believe can make a dent in the PC component space with PSU's like this.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: There will be interference.
reviews.comment: Electromagnetic interference is severe, causing extremely poor signal quality for wireless network cards and Bluetooth devices, with the problem disappearing immediately after unplugging the power.
